summary: March 2026 highlights: audit logging for users, teams, orgs, role assignments, preferences and direct component access; Django 5.2 LTS across gateway, hub, controller and Lightspeed, which requires a new installer for containerized and RPM; and many CVE fixes.
questions: Do I need a new installer for the March 2026 AAP patch?
Does AAP log changes to role assignments?
Which AAP components moved to Django 5.2?

answer_card.title: March 2026 patch highlights
answer_card.answer_md:
- Audit logging for users, teams, organizations, role assignments, dynamic preferences and direct component access
- **Django 5.2 LTS** for gateway, hub, controller and Lightspeed. All users must use a **new installer** (containerized and RPM)
- CVE fixes across UI, controller, gateway, hub, Lightspeed and packaging
